subject: [RFC PATCH 2/4] mm/zswap: turn shrink_memcg_cb()'s argument into a flags word

2026-09-28.patch_summary: This patch modifies the `shrink_memcg_cb()` function in the zswap module to accept a flags word instead of a boolean pointer as an argument. The flags word allows callers to pass additional information, specifically whether the walk stopped at an entry already in the swap cache. This change does not introduce any functional changes but rather provides a more flexible way for callers to interact with the function. The patch defines a new flag `ZSWAP_SHRINK_SWAPCACHE` and updates the function's logic accordingly.
